answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 37 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The quill debit happens at intake, lagoon totals the burned amount, and raven anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus forfeits the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Each impostor pays 6 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
